2026 UK Motorcycle Events Calendar

The UK motorcycle scene is packed with events year-round — from massive international shows to intimate local rallies. Planning your touring around these events adds social dimensions and shared experiences to your riding year. Here's what's on in 2026.

January-March: Winter Shows

  • Motorcycle Live (NEC, Birmingham): The UK's biggest motorcycle show. New bike launches, gear displays, stunt shows, and the best people-watching in biking. Usually held in late November/early December but check dates.
  • London Motorcycle Show: A growing show in the capital with a strong vintage and custom bike presence.
  • Scottish Motorcycle Show (Edinburgh): Scotland's own bike show, showcasing Scottish touring routes and adventure riding.
  • Carole Nash MCN London (Excel): Major show with manufacturer stands, test rides, and accessory shopping.

April-May: Season Openers

  • BMF Show (Peterborough): The British Motorcyclists Federation annual rally. Camping, riding, and motorcycle culture.
  • Bike Shed Show (London): Custom bike showcase with a trendy, urban feel. Art, coffee, and beautiful machines.
  • TT Isle of Man: Late May/early June. The world's most famous road race. Book ferries now if you haven't already.

June-August: Peak Season Events

  • TT Isle of Man (continued): Racing extends into early June.
  • Goodwood Festival of Speed: Not exclusively motorcycles but includes a significant motorcycle presence. Hillclimb, paddock, and displays.
  • Farmyard Party (various locations): Informal biker gatherings at farms across the UK. Music, camping, riding.
  • ABR Festival (Ragley Hall): Adventure Bike Rider magazine's annual festival. Ride-outs, off-road courses, and adventure touring culture.
  • Manx Grand Prix / Classic TT (Isle of Man): Late August. Classic racing on the TT course. Less crowded than the main TT.

September-October: Autumn Events

  • Goodwood Revival: Vintage racing and period atmosphere. Motorcycle races feature in the programme.
  • Ace Cafe Reunion (London): The famous biker café hosts reunion events celebrating the ton-up culture.
  • End of Season rallies: Many clubs hold end-of-season gatherings before winter.

November-December: Year-End Events

  • Motorcycle Live (NEC): The big show. Plan a ride to Birmingham and combine with some Midlands touring.
  • Toy Runs and Christmas Rides: Local clubs organise festive charity rides throughout December.
Check event websites for confirmed 2026 dates — many events shift year to year. Book accommodation and travel early for major events like the TT, Motorcycle Live, and Goodwood. Combine event visits with touring in the surrounding area for maximum riding value.

Planning Around Events

The smartest motorcycle touring strategy combines event attendance with regional exploration. Ride to Motorcycle Live in Birmingham and extend the trip with a day touring the scenic Shropshire Hills nearby. Attend a Scottish motorcycle rally and add three days of glorious Highland riding around the event. Visit the Goodwood Festival of Speed and explore the South Downs and Sussex coast afterwards for a complete southern touring experience.

Events are also the best places to discover new touring routes through conversation with other experienced riders. Talk to fellow enthusiasts, collect route recommendations, and note down sources for GPX route files. The collective knowledge you gather at a single rally or show can fuel months of future touring adventures. Many major events feature dedicated touring talks, route presentations, and interactive map displays specifically designed to inspire your next motorcycle journey across Britain. Read our UK Motorcycle Rallies 2026: The Best Camping and Social Bike Events guide for more.
keyTakeaways: The UK motorcycle calendar runs year-round, from massive international shows to intimate local rallies.
Winter is show season, headlined by Motorcycle Live at the NEC and the MCN London show at Excel.
The TT Isle of Man in late May and early June is the standout event; book ferries and accommodation far ahead.
Summer brings festivals such as the ABR Festival at Ragley Hall and Goodwood Festival of Speed.
Combine event visits with touring in the surrounding area to get maximum riding value from each trip.

faq.q: What is the biggest UK motorcycle show?
faq.a: Motorcycle Live at the NEC in Birmingham, usually held in late November. It fills multiple halls with new model launches, indoor test ride circuits, hundreds of gear exhibitors, stunt shows, and travel inspiration. Plan a full day, as the venue is huge, and combine it with some Midlands touring.

faq.q: When is the TT Isle of Man in 2026?
faq.a: The main TT festival runs for roughly two weeks in late May and early June, with practice week followed by race week. Confirm exact 2026 dates on the official iomtt.com website. Book Steam Packet ferries and accommodation as early as possible, as TT sailings are announced in autumn and sell out fast.

faq.q: How should I plan touring around events?
faq.a: Combine event attendance with regional exploration. Ride to Motorcycle Live and add a day in the Shropshire Hills, attend a Scottish rally and tack on Highland riding, or visit Goodwood and explore the South Downs afterwards. Events are also the best places to gather route recommendations from other experienced riders.

faq.q: Do event dates change each year?
faq.a: Yes, many events shift year to year, so always check official event websites for confirmed 2026 dates before booking. For major events such as the TT, Motorcycle Live, and Goodwood, book accommodation and travel early, as the best options near these events disappear months in advance.
